lessons.claim: The exact-OU reduction of a trapped bead under constant-velocity drive is confirmed against HOOMD Brownian at k* = 21221, dt/tau_k = 0.002, T_obs/tau_k = 322.9, N = 1000: measured <x>/d against -v*/k* is within -0.36 to +0.14 %, var(x)/d^2 against 1/k* within -1.31 to +0.03 %, and the slope d<x>/dv against -1/k* is +0.032 %. Wall time 0.5 min, 17x cheaper than the 8.6 min estimated from trap-2d-5um's 332.5 steps/s -- a trap-only system has no neighbour list, so that rate does not transfer.
